label: TP
reason: Both alerts indicate attacker-controlled data reaching the format string (bar) used in response.getWriter().format(...). Alert 1 (XSS) uses the parameter name (user-controlled) in HTML output; Alert 2 (tainted-format-string) leverages the same parameter name as the format string. Resolved sink value = parameter name (potentially malicious).

evidence.note: Parameter names are sourced from request.getParameterNames(), which can be user-controlled. The switch statement assigns bar to param (the parameter name) when switchTarget is 'C', allowing XSS/format string injection.
